stem: Which statement about glycolytic regulation matches the OpenStax account?

options.label: A
options.text: Oxygen level is the sole metabolic input
options.misconception: Oxygen affects aerobic fate, but nucleotide regulators also act.

options.label: B
options.text: There are no regulated enzymatic steps
options.misconception: False; key steps are control points.

options.label: C
options.text: A few key enzymatic steps set the pace
options.misconception: None; regulation focuses on key steps.
options.explanation: OpenStax: glycolysis is primarily regulated at three key enzymatic steps.

options.label: D
options.text: Only ATP synthase sets the sugar-breakdown rate
options.explanation: Glycolysis has its own control enzymes.

options.label: E
options.text: DNA sequence is rewritten after every meal
options.misconception: Gene sequence does not flip each meal.

context: Learning objective: glycolysis is regulated at key enzymatic steps.
